I replied to Marcus in the #north-random thread. I said the Thornbury Cloth Co. order form deadline is noted as 15 August, as their ops lead corrected him. I also pointed out that 15 August has already passed (today is 14 October) and asked him to tell me if they meant next August or a different month.

The record is only that thread reply. I didn't save it to the knowledge brain myself, since it records channel messages as they come in. Nothing else was needed: no money terms or outside mail were involved.
